title: Choosing an academic polishing skill
subtitle: Three locally installed skills · Static inspection of selected instructions · 2026-10-27
requirement: Make light edits by default, preserve citations, ask before rewriting a paragraph, and explain changes.
conclusion: Among the instructions inspected, paper-polish comes closest to a light-editing workflow. academic-humanizer can match an author's voice, while nature-polishing also addresses section structure.
footer: This static comparison describes the instructions inspected, not actual polishing performance or a security audit. Supporting files and scripts were not reviewed in full. Actual behavior depends on the user's instructions and environment.

candidates.name: paper-polish
candidates.tagline: Conservative language editing that preserves the author's meaning

rows.label: Editing scope
rows.value: Prefers small edits; asks before structural rewriting
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 90–101: prefers light edits and asks the author to choose before rewriting beyond the sentence level. This does not explicitly cover every paragraph rewrite.
~/.codex/skills/paper-polish\SKILL.md:90

rows.label: Meaning and citations
rows.value: Does not silently change meaning or add citations
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 42–81: changes that may affect scientific meaning must be flagged; new citations must not be added. The inspected text did not establish a rule to preserve every existing citation.
~/.codex/skills/paper-polish\SKILL.md:42

rows.label: Revision notes
rows.value: Explains major changes and flags meaning risks
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 226–239: deliver polished text and concise notes; use before-and-after comparisons for changes that may affect meaning.
~/.codex/skills/paper-polish\SKILL.md:226

rows.label: File handling
rows.value: Defaults to editing workspace files in place
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 201–207: edit workspace LaTeX or Markdown files directly and use the version diff as a record. Actual operations remain subject to the user's instructions.
~/.codex/skills/paper-polish\SKILL.md:201

candidates.note: Suitable for conservative language editing; explicitly request a preview first if needed.

candidates.name: academic-humanizer
candidates.tagline: Remove formulaic AI phrasing and match the author's voice

rows.label: Editing scope
rows.value: Preserves structure and content while calibrating claims
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 36–46: audit before rewriting, preserve structure, content, and citations, and calibrate overclaims.
~/.codex/skills/academic-humanizer\SKILL.md:36

rows.label: Meaning and citations
rows.value: Preserves citations, though an example creates tension
rows.evidence:
Line 154 prohibits dropping or changing citations; lines 114–118 suggest retaining only the most relevant references in a citation-dumping example. This is a potential tension, not evidence of a runtime failure.
~/.codex/skills/academic-humanizer\SKILL.md:114
~/.codex/skills/academic-humanizer\SKILL.md:154

rows.label: Revision notes
rows.value: Provides a short change log and voice notes
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 36–46 and 259–261: return cleaned text and a short report on writing patterns, claim changes, and voice.
~/.codex/skills/academic-humanizer\SKILL.md:36

rows.label: Voice matching
rows.value: Can use the author's supplied writing samples
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 177–181: use supplied prior papers to observe sentence rhythm, connectives, and phrasing.
~/.codex/skills/academic-humanizer\SKILL.md:177

candidates.note: Useful for author voice and AI-like phrasing; clarify the citation rule if preserving every reference is essential.

candidates.name: nature-polishing
candidates.tagline: Routes polishing by paper type, section, language, and journal

rows.label: Editing scope
rows.value: Can diagnose and adjust section or paragraph logic
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md lines 39–53: load rules by paper type and section before addressing logic and sentences. The output guide requires disclosure when section logic changes.
~/.codex/skills/nature-polishing\SKILL.md:39
~/.codex/skills/nature-polishing\static\core\output-format.md:3

rows.label: Meaning and citations
rows.value: Preserves facts, evidence boundaries, and citation intent
rows.evidence:
The SKILL.md description requires preserving facts, evidence boundaries, and citation intent. The inspected materials did not establish a rule to preserve each existing citation key.
~/.codex/skills/nature-polishing\SKILL.md:3

rows.label: Revision notes
rows.evidence:
static/core/output-format.md: return polished text and 3–5 notes; provide original, polished, and rationale when requested.
~/.codex/skills/nature-polishing\static\core\output-format.md:1

rows.label: Supporting files
rows.value: Loads section rules and shared resources as needed
rows.evidence:
SKILL.md and manifest.yaml route by paper type, section, language, and journal and reference neighboring nature-shared resources.
~/.codex/skills/nature-polishing\SKILL.md:19
~/.codex/skills/nature-polishing\manifest.yaml:6

candidates.note: Useful for section-level diagnosis and journal style; state editing limits explicitly for a light-edit request.
